name: Abadia Retuerta LeDomaine
positioning: A former 12th-century Romanesque abbey turned hotel on a 700-hectare wine estate in the Ribera del Duero region, less than two hours from Madrid
best_for: Wine lovers who want to stay on a working wine estate with its own designation of origin
Couples looking for a quiet countryside stay with a spa suite for two
Travelers drawn to historic architecture and art

facts.text: The hotel is in the province of Valladolid, in the heart of the Ribera del Duero wine region.
Abadia Retuerta is less than two hours from Madrid, in the Duero Valley.
The property sits on an estate of 700 hectares.
All of the rooms overlook the vineyards.
An a la carte breakfast is included in the room rate.
The abbey has vaulted ceilings, thick stone walls and a silent cloister.
A shuttle service is available on request, and bicycles are provided for guests.
Vinoteca is a contemporary Castilian tavern that reinterprets tradition and local ingredients.
Diners at Refectorio can see peeling frescoes while working through a prix-fixe menu.
The spa has a Spa Suite, a private space for couples to enjoy treatments together.
The winery's main grape varieties are Tempranillo, Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, Merlot and Sauvignon Blanc.
The estate produces wine salt, flower honey from its own beehives, and pine nuts.

highlights.text: The hotel is a former 12th-century Romanesque abbey converted into a hotel.
Since May 2022 the estate has had its own Protected Designation of Origin for its wine.
Santuario Wellness and Spa offers a Spa Sommelier concept that blends wellness with wine culture.
The hotel has an art collection with Renaissance, Baroque and modern pieces, including a sculpture by Eduardo Chillida.
Guests have a butler service available 24 hours a day.

considerations.text: Calicata Terroir Bar, the wine bar in the winery, is open during the summer season.
Spa access for children under 16 is restricted to set hours and conditions.
WhataHotel notes the remote countryside location requires transportation.
